_comment: eTender's own tender evaluation schema, registered by eTender in the Decision Engine (INTEGRATION-DESIGN §1.3). Derived from the engine's BEF-based tender_bid_evaluation v1, changed only where eTender's data differs: the two document gates are officer attestations (score_source: caller) because eTender has no bank-guarantee document type to check automatically; technical notes are optional text, as on eTender's bid record; inputs eTender does not hold are omitted. The BEF schema stays untouched for its regression role. Any edit here registers a new schema version on the next publish — versions are immutable once used.
label: eTender bid evaluation

criteria.label: Bid submitted before closing
criteria.guidance: Enforced by eTender: submission closes at the deadline and no later bid can exist. Kept for the audit record.

criteria.label: Bank guarantee submitted and valid
criteria.guidance: Attested by a procurement officer, who records who checked it and when. eTender stores the attestation; the engine records the result.

criteria.label: All mandatory documents present
criteria.guidance: Attested by a procurement officer. A failure routes the bid to review rather than rejecting it, so a person decides.

criteria.label: Price competitiveness
criteria.guidance: Computed arithmetically across the batch: 100 − (value − best) / best × 100, never below 0.

criteria.label: Technical specifications
criteria.guidance: Scored by MPC's evaluators and entered in eTender.

criteria.label: Project timeline
criteria.guidance: Formula chosen per tender by contract type. Duration is stated by the vendor on the bid, sealed with the price.

criteria.label: References and past performance
criteria.guidance: Scored by MPC's evaluators and entered in eTender.

criteria.label: Payment flexibility
criteria.guidance: Scored by MPC's evaluators from the payment terms the bid states.
